zh-CN.intro: 0.1.6 带来了本机模型、统一模型选择、Pi 扩展和插件持久作品库，并重新整理了任务导航、移动端列表与多 Agent 运行体验。Mac 和 Windows 将随本版更新；iOS 和 Android 都可直接获得内容更新，已经安装 0.1.5 的用户无需重新安装，iOS 也不需要新的 TestFlight 构建。

topics.title: 在 Mira 里安装和使用本机模型
topics.text: 桌面端现在可以直接安装、启动和管理 Ollama，并下载适合当前电脑的本机模型；已经运行的 Ollama 服务也可以继续使用。模型文件和推理都留在自己的电脑上，不需要另外打开 Ollama App。

topics.title: 模型和供应商集中到一个选择器
topics.text: 新的模型选择器把模型、供应商、收藏和当前引擎放在同一个面板中。收藏可以保留对应的引擎、推理强度与 Fast 设置，切换引擎前会明确确认，常用组合更容易找到也不易选错。

topics.title: 在设置中管理 Pi 扩展
topics.text: 桌面端可以安装、更新、启用或卸载 Pi 扩展，并在安装前检查兼容情况。扩展会与 Pi 在同一环境中运行，因此 Mira 会在安装和更新前说明它可接触的内容并要求确认；变更会在新建或重启 Pi 任务后生效。

topics.title: 插件可以保留自己的持久作品库
topics.text: 支持这一能力的插件现在可以保存画布、图片和数据库等较大的作品数据。你可以选择或迁移存储位置；卸载插件不会删除作品，删除数据需要在设置中单独确认。

topics.title: 插件浏览和更新更顺手
topics.text: 未登录时也可以浏览公开插件，组织内插件和本机安装状态仍保持隐藏。打开插件提供的外部链接前会先确认，插件更新后也会留在已安装列表并保持启用状态，不再重复要求确认相同权限。

topics.title: 长任务和多 Agent 协同更稳
topics.text: 本机 Agent 在上下文接近上限时可以接力继续，子 Agent 会保留与主任务的连接，计划、排队消息和完成结果也更可靠地回到原任务。任务结束后不易残留假忙状态，切换任务时正在润色的语音消息也会发回原处。

topics.title: 任务排序和侧栏状态更清楚
topics.text: 正在运行的任务会及时提前，任务排序与项目手动顺序可以分别管理，远程任务也进入侧栏搜索。过期摘要不再占位，并补充生成速度、可选 worktree 标记、自动化分组和折叠状态等信息。

topics.title: 手机端更容易找任务和继续输入
topics.text: 手机端补齐任务优先级、项目顺序和分组偏好，并能在设备间保持一致。输入框和语音按钮不再随内容跳位，展开消息不会超出边界，排队消息的插话区域更好点按，长时间浏览消息时的内存占用也更稳定。

topics.title: 模型供应商兼容范围继续扩大
topics.text: Pi 可以更准确地接入第三方模型供应商，Grok 4.6、按供应商选择媒体模型、个性化子 Agent 模型和自定义推理强度也得到补齐。LiteLLM、xAI 与自定义供应商遇到中断或格式问题时会给出更准确的结果，SuperGrok 还能显示每周用量的价值估算。

topics.title: 桌面端常用细节一起整理
topics.text: 设置页、标题栏和 Windows 窗口控件重新对齐，图标按钮和滑杆补齐提示与辅助说明。确认框仍可拖动，置顶计划可以手动关闭，Obsidian wiki-link 图片可以直接预览，聊天区和侧栏在窄窗口下也更稳。

en.intro: Mira 0.1.6 adds local models, a unified model picker, Pi extension management, and durable libraries for plugins. It also reshapes task navigation, mobile lists, and multi-agent continuity. Mac and Windows will update with this release. iOS and Android receive it as an in-app content update, so users who already have 0.1.5 installed do not need to reinstall or wait for a new TestFlight build.

topics.title: Install and use local models inside Mira
topics.text: The desktop app can now install, start, and manage Ollama, then download local models suited to the current computer. An existing Ollama service continues to work as well. Model files and inference stay on your own computer, without requiring the Ollama app to remain open.

topics.title: Models and providers share one picker
topics.text: The new model picker brings models, providers, favorites, and the active engine into one panel. A favorite can retain its engine, reasoning effort, and Fast setting. Engine changes are confirmed before they take effect, making common combinations easier to find and harder to misconfigure.

topics.title: Manage Pi extensions in settings
topics.text: The desktop app can install, update, enable, and remove Pi extensions, with compatibility details shown before installation. Extensions run in the same environment as Pi, so Mira explains what they may access and asks for confirmation before an install or update. Changes apply to new or restarted Pi tasks.

topics.title: Plugins can keep a durable work library
topics.text: Plugins that support this capability can now store larger work data such as canvases, images, and databases. You can choose or move the storage location. Uninstalling the plugin keeps the work, while deleting the data requires a separate confirmation in settings.

topics.title: Smoother plugin browsing and updates
topics.text: Public plugins can now be browsed before signing in, while organization-only entries and local install state remain hidden. Mira confirms before opening an external link from a plugin. After an update, a plugin stays in the installed list and keeps its enabled state without asking you to approve unchanged permissions again.

topics.title: More dependable long tasks and multi-agent work
topics.text: Local agents can hand off when their context approaches its limit, subagents preserve their link to the parent task, and plans, queued messages, and completion results return more reliably to the original task. Finished work is less likely to leave a false busy state, and voice text being polished still returns to the task where it began.

topics.title: Clearer task ordering and sidebar status
topics.text: Running tasks move up promptly, task ordering is independent from manual project order, and remote tasks now appear in sidebar search. Stale summaries no longer take space, while generation speed, optional working-directory badges, automation groups, and collapse states provide a clearer overview.

topics.title: Find tasks and keep typing more easily on mobile
topics.text: Mobile now supports task priority, project order, and grouping preferences that stay consistent across devices. The composer and voice button no longer shift with content, expanded messages stay within their bounds, queued messages have a larger interruption target, and memory use remains steadier during long reading sessions.

topics.title: Broader model-provider compatibility
topics.text: Pi can connect to third-party model providers more accurately, with added support for Grok 4.6, provider-specific media models, personalized subagent models, and custom reasoning effort. LiteLLM, xAI, and custom-provider interruptions or format errors are reported more accurately, while SuperGrok can estimate the weekly value of used Tokens.

topics.title: Everyday desktop details are better aligned
topics.text: Settings, the title bar, and Windows window controls are aligned more consistently, with better hints and accessibility labels for icon buttons and sliders. Confirmation dialogs remain movable, pinned plans can be dismissed, Obsidian wiki-link images can be previewed, and chat and sidebar resizing behave better in narrow windows.
